# Bernardino Martin Home Services

Bernardino Martin is a licensed, bonded, and insured home services contractor serving Los Angeles and the Greater San Fernando Valley. We provide HVAC, solar, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, and smart home services with 24/7 emergency availability.

Contact: (818) 400-0227 | martinsolarstar@gmail.com
